description: Show how many credits this WhoisXML API account has left on each product, and which tools spend each product's credits. This call spends no credits. Use it before a large or bulk job to check that the account can cover it, or after a call fails for lack of credits. A product the account holds without a credit limit is marked unlimited instead of showing a number. Do NOT use this to look up domains, IP addresses or emails: it reads only the account's own balances.
name: account_balance
